item.title: Happy Camper for Saturday, March 7, 2026
item.description: Mahalo, Dave Sharma of the Kauai District Health Office (they’ve got their annual Open House as part of National Public Health Week coming up on April 10!) for dropping off copies of the 2026 Kauai Community Calendar that starts off with the many (!!!) different ways of saying “Hello, friend!”

item.title: Former U.S Rep. Colleen Hanabusa dies at age 74
item.description: HONOLULU — Colleen Hanabusa, a former state lawmaker and prominent labor lawyer from Waianae who served in Congress but failed at bids to become Hawaii’s governor and Honolulu’s mayor, died Friday, her family confirmed. She was 74.

item.title: House fire on Kahuna Road displaces two
item.description: KAPAA — Firefighters with the Kauai Fire Department extinguished a structure fire reported shortly before 9 a.m. on Kahuna Road in Kapaa on Thursday.

item.title: Learning Lab at Kauai Veterans Memorial Hospital named
item.description: The Hawaii Health Systems Corporation Kauai Region, led by Kauai Region CEO Lance Segawa and Kauai Region Education Manager Taryn Morita, dedicated the Simulation Learning Lab at the Kauai Veterans Memorial Hospital campus to Dr. Tom and Jane Royer on Thursday, honoring a lifetime of service to exceptional patient care and medical education.

item.title: Injured hiker rescued by KFD recruits from Uluwehi Trail
item.description: LIHUE — Personnel from the Kauai Fire Department Class rescued an injured 64-year-old female Illinois visitor from the Uluwehi Trail, also known as Secret Falls Trail, in Wailua on Feb. 27.

item.title: Health officials confirm measles case in visitor to Hawaii
item.description: Hawaii health officials say they have confirmed a case of measles in a vaccinated adult visitor to Oahu.

item.title: West Oahu refinery to produce plant-based biofuels
item.description: Par Hawaii Refining LLC, a more than 50-year-old petroleum refinery in James Campbell Industrial Park, says this month it will start up the largest renewable fuel production facility in Hawaii.

item.title: Man, 33, dead after extrication from closed area of Volcanoes National Park
item.description: A 33-year-old man is dead following an overnight rescue operation at Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park last week, according to the National Park Service.

item.title: Pacific leaders want cheaper flights and better internet access
item.description: At a potentially historic business and diplomatic conference held last week at the East-West Center in Manoa, leaders from Pacific Island nations and territories talked to American business leaders about how to connect their remote islands — and their people — with the American economy.

item.title: Eddie is a no-go as season holding period ends
item.description: The Rip Curl Eddie Aikau Big Wave Invitational is a no-go this season, with waves and conditions not meeting requirements, according to organizers.
